about_title: Built to make PDF extraction feel clear, practical, and reliable.
about_description: Dokumen AI helps teams upload documents, define the fields they care about, and turn messy PDFs into structured data without heavyweight setup.
about_feature_setup_body: Create a project, upload files, and start annotating in minutes.
about_feature_review_body: Keep people in the loop while building extraction confidence.
about_why_body_1: Many document workflows still depend on copy-paste, fragile templates, or expensive custom builds. This product is meant to close that gap with a cleaner workflow for teams who need repeatable extraction from real-world PDFs.
about_why_body_2: The goal is simple: keep the interface approachable, let models do the heavy lifting, and give users enough control to review, correct, and improve results over time.
about_step_upload_body: Bring in contracts, invoices, forms, and reports.
about_step_label_body: Mark the entities you want once and reuse them across projects.
about_step_extract_body: Run models, compare outputs, and export structured results.
about_founder_description: Charlie started Dokumen AI to make document extraction simpler for teams that need clean, structured data from messy PDFs without adding unnecessary complexity.

pricing_hero_description: Every workspace starts at $10/month, then usage is billed from the exact LLM tokens you consume. Developers manage projects and analysts focus on labeling and review.
pricing_how_description: Every LLM extraction call is metered by token count and recorded in PostgreSQL for the monthly charge.
pricing_step_1_body: Upload your PDFs and define the entity types you want to extract. Label a handful of examples to guide the model.
pricing_step_2_body: Dokumen sends your documents to your chosen model. Input and output tokens are recorded at the exact rate in our billing table.
pricing_step_3_body: On the monthly charge date, Dokumen creates a Stripe card payment for the $10 account base fee plus accumulated token usage.
pricing_plan_description: Individual accounts are $10 per month plus model usage. Organization accounts are $10 per user per month plus model usage.
pricing_plan_metered_note: + LLM usage metered from our live pricing table
pricing_role_developer_body: Full project permissions: create projects, upload PDFs, manage entity types, and run extraction workflows.
pricing_role_analyst_body: Limited to labeling and reviewing pre-uploaded PDFs. Analysts can work inside the project without changing project setup.
pricing_payment_note: Add a payment method after sign-up to activate extraction
pricing_models_description: The rates below are the exact values our workers use to compute database-recorded usage charges. Prices are per 1 million tokens.
pricing_models_note: Rates are read live from our billing table and match what workers charge per request.
pricing_faq_a1: Dokumen records charges in PostgreSQL and uses Stripe only to process saved card payments on the monthly charge date.
pricing_faq_q2: What if I don't add a payment method?
pricing_faq_a2: You can still explore public pages, but app access requires a saved payment method. Your first charge is one month after billing starts.
pricing_faq_q3: Can I choose which model to use?
pricing_faq_a3: Yes. Each extraction request lets you pick among the models listed above. Cheaper models are great for high-volume pipelines; larger models excel on complex documents.
pricing_faq_a4: Creating an account requires saving a valid payment method. You are not charged until the first monthly charge date.
pricing_faq_a5: Payment methods can be managed from the billing page. Access remains tied to having a valid default payment method on file.
pricing_bottom_description: Create an account, upload your first PDF, and add a payment method in under five minutes.

platform_description: Dokumen connects document sources, model workflows, storage, and billing into one operating layer for turning PDFs into structured data.
platform_hero_panel_item_documents: Documents arrive from teams and systems
platform_hero_panel_item_models: OCR and extraction models process each file
platform_hero_panel_item_storage: Structured data returns to projects and workflows
platform_architecture_description: The public web app, FastAPI, workers, databases, storage, and GPU services stay separated so each part can scale around its responsibility.
platform_providers_description: The only mandatory providers are AWS for infrastructure, Cloudflare for DNS and WAF, Runpod for GPU workloads, and Stripe for payments. Model and productivity providers are optional integrations.
platform_sources_description: Document sources mirror the worker provider registries and show the connectors the ingestion layer is designed to watch or receive events from.
